scenarios.title: Root proof before Default: with a fresh temporary QUIRKY_HOME on macOS 14+, read <QUIRKY_HOME>/desktop/native-browser-storage-id and derive the expected Default store UUID (first 16 bytes of sha256(id + '\n' + 'persist:quirky-browser-default')). Open one Native pane on Default and confirm it loads (the host refuses to claim a guest whose live store identifier differs), and that ~/Library/WebKit/<bundle id>/WebsiteDataStore/<that UUID, lowercase> now exists. No Default scenario runs if the pane fails to claim or the directory is missing.

After SC5-native passes, load a local fixture that sets a cookie and a localStorage value in a Default Native pane, close every Default pane, then use Browser Settings > Session & Cookies > Clear cookies & site data > Clear Data. Expect no error, Default still listed, and a reopened Default Native pane on the fixture reading no cookie and no localStorage value.

Create a fresh UUID profile, store fixture cookie/localStorage in a Native pane on it, close the pane, then Remove it from Browser Settings and confirm. Expect the profile gone from the list and its Chrome directory removed; recreate nothing. A second fresh profile's fixture data stays readable throughout.

On macOS 13 (or a desktop host built on stock Electrobun), Browser Settings > Session & Cookies says clearing needs macOS 14 or later and is unavailable here; Clear Data shows the refusal and the profile's Chrome data and metadata stay.
